row.Selected-grade rationale: Documented commercial formulation; traceable manufacturer evidence Filed under TPC / TPEE on 2026-09-28 (m223-what-the-makers-say-it-is), moved from TPE, polymer not stated: copolyester elastomer, "1,4-Benzenedicarboxylic acid, dimethyl ester, polymer with 1,4-butanediol and .alpha.- 9078-71-1 - >96" (D-FIBERLOGY-FIBERFLEX-30D-SDS-EN, p. 2). Fiberlogy's safety data sheets, in every revision found (2018, 2022, 2025), name a copolyester of terephthalate, butanediol and poly(tetramethylene ether) glycol (CAS 9078-71-1, over 96 %): a TPC. Its product page calls it TPU, and names nothing else; its sheet's density (1.07), melting point (170 to 174 °C) and Shore D 30 are a copolyester elastomer's (DuPont Hytrel 3078 prints 1.07 and 177 °C). The safety data sheet decides. Read by an AI agent (claude-opus-5.5), not a person.
